Think of it as 360 degrees of pressure, not just sucking your stomach in. Before you unrack, take a big breath into your belly, low, so your lower ribs and sides expand, not your chest. Then brace like you're about to take a punch: tighten your abs outward against your belt line, as if you're trying to push your stomach out against a belt.

Hold that air and that tension the whole way down and back up. Let it out only once you're past the sticking point or back at the top, then reset your breath before the next rep. If you lose the brace mid-rep, that's usually a sign the weight is ahead of the skill, so drop it a bit and own the pattern.

A quick check is to put your hands on your sides at the bottom of your ribs and feel them push out when you breathe in. If you want, send me a video and I can open the form check.
